send.counter_note: last recorded snapshot; may precede final packet

receive.counter_note: last recorded snapshot; may precede final packet

interpretation.selection: Complete measurement ProbeRTT intervals; first/last 2 ms excluded. Receiver phases use correlated sender packet identities, not clock-offset subtraction.
interpretation.linux_software_tx: Software scheduler/driver boundary, shared with the first segment of a potentially segmented submission; not wire departure.
interpretation.darwin_rx: UDP delivery timestamp before socket append; excludes earlier NIC/driver/IP processing.
interpretation.residual: Combined Linux post-software-TX through Darwin socket delivery and Darwin pre-write-call through Linux software RX. Includes unavailable Darwin TX, kernel/driver/NIC/network work; not one-way or pure propagation.
interpretation.partial_cycles: Raw RTT minus receiver socket-delivery-to-ACK-write-start and sender kernel-RX-to-protocol-receive, each measured on the same correlated cycle. The remainder retains sender logical-send-to-TX residence; no typical TX cost or GSO internal-packet mapping is substituted. Complete cycles are a subset, not an independent cohort.
interpretation.sampling: Identity selection about 1/16 in each direction; complete cycles require both independent identities plus the first Linux GSO segment. No confidence interval or representative tail claim.
interpretation.ack_write_batch_count_marker: Event8 field5 is accepted entries on the batch path and constant1 on the single-write path; it is not universal proof of successful submission.
interpretation.negative_values: Retained and counted; inspect clock uncertainty, boundary semantics and capture validity before interpretation.

send.clock: monotime; Unix anchor is a sequential observation, never cross-host one-way time

receive.clock: monotime; Unix anchor is a sequential observation, never cross-host one-way time
